analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 하락 마감, RSI 43.5로 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 210.3152에서 -327.0548로 악화되며 약세 수렴 중. ADX 7.8로 추세 미형성 구간으로, 변동성 확대 가능성 상존. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성 있으나, MACD 악화와 무추세 구간으로 인해 매수 진입은 보류.
analysis.reasonEn: Three consecutive days of decline, RSI at 43.5 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsening from 210.3152 to -327.0548, indicating bearish convergence. ADX at 7.8 signifies a non-trending phase with potential for increased volatility. While the 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, suggesting a potential Higher Low pattern, the worsening MACD and lack of trend warrant a hold on new buy entries.

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.77배): 움직임의 신뢰도 위축.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 과매도 진입 및 ADX 무추세로 매수 진입 보류.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (105,915 KRW) vs SMA5 (109,980 KRW)/SMA20 (109,773 KRW)/SMA50 (106,277 KRW): below short/mid-term trend, entering below SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100 (116,378 KRW)/SMA200 (98,389 KRW): weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (54.8%) + current price level at historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.7→43.5): entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (210.3152→-327.0548): worsening, bearish convergence diagnosed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 104,732 KRW): approaching lower band, band width at 9.18% expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (104,045 KRW): based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (111,355 KRW): potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming): potential recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): holding off on buy entry due to RSI entering oversold and ADX non-trending.
